test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The student requested them to take him to the reception.

options.text: “Take me to the reception now,” said the student.
“Take me to the reception,” said the student.
“Please take me to the reception," said the student.
“Please take me in the reception,” said the student.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The student requested them to take him to the reception.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"requested them" becomes "Please"**
 
 
• The polite request "requested" is converted to "Please" in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"to take him" becomes "take me"**
 
 
• Pronoun "him" is changed to "me" to match direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Please" and ends with a comma before the reporting clause.
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Please take me to the reception," said the student.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Take me to the reception now," said the student." 

 
 
• Adds "now" which is not present in the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Take me to the reception," said the student." 
 
 
• Lacks the polite request "please" from the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Please take me in the reception," said the student." 
 
 
• Incorrect preposition "in" instead of "to".
